newsitem.title: USA: U.S. to sell $26 billion of 3-, 6-mo bills Feb 24.
newsitem.headline: U.S. to sell $26 billion of 3-, 6-mo bills Feb 24.

text.p: The Treasury Department said on Tuesday it will auction $26 billion of three- and six-month bills on Feb 24 to pay down $150 million as $26.141 billion of bills are maturing.
The weekly bill sale will be equally divided between the two maturities. The bills will be issued on Feb 27. The three-month bills mature on May 29 and the six-month bills mature on Aug 28.
The CUSIP number for the three-month bills is 9127942Q6 and for the six-month bills is 9127945K6.
